title: 公共内容视频平台登录复用
changes: YouTube使用常规播放器域名，详情提供平台观看与刷新预览；iframe加载不冒充登录或播放成功
同一浏览器在平台完成一次登录后复用有效Cookie，按平台记忆观看偏好；列表和详情共用观看入口，不读取或保存平台凭据
不同视频安全打开平台页面，同平台最近同一视频可聚焦已有窗口；登录过期或清除Cookie后由用户重新登录
仅记录官方渠道视频下载能力核验，无OSS接入、下载或额外收费调用

validation.development: 22/22 frontend tests; full web typecheck; targeted lint and format; isolated server-mode build; 11 synthetic Edge scenarios on desktop and 390px; zero page errors.
validation.release: Repeat tests/regression/typecheck/lint/isolated DB/UI, validation builds and CI wait skipped by user policy. Official frontend and API image each generated once.
validation.limitations: Actual platform account login and real-video playback require user acceptance. Third-party cookie restrictions, platform challenges and session expiry still apply. Download capability verified from official documentation only; OSS not integrated.
